captions.detailed: A traditional stone parish church tower with a grey masonry finish, featuring a crenellated parapet at the top and rectangular belfry window openings. Inside the belfry chamber, a single bronze bell is suspended from a dark wooden headstock yoke. The headstock is mounted on a horizontal revolute axle supported by an internal timber frame, allowing the bell to swing back and forth, and a large wooden rope wheel is attached to the side of the headstock for ringing.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an English parish church stone tower with a crenellated parapet and a belfry. Inside the belfry, include a timber frame supporting a bronze bell on a dark wooden headstock yoke, which is configured with a revolute joint to swing, and attach a wooden rope-pull wheel to the side of the headstock.
captions.factory: Construct the main tower base and belfry chamber using hollowed box primitives, cutting out rectangular belfry windows and crenellations along the top rim. Inside the belfry, build a static timber support frame from wooden beam boxes. Model the swinging assembly as a child part consisting of a wooden headstock box, a revolved bell shape, and a thin cylinder wheel on the side, connected to the frame via a revolute joint aligned along the horizontal Y-axis.
